rules.title: Order placement action from cart
rules.description: Cart page must expose place-order workflow controls with totals and line forms.

rules.title: Placed order listing view
rules.description: Orders list must show table structure with order id, total, status, and details link.

rules.title: Workflow UI selectors
rules.description: Styles should include cart place-order row, totals, and product quantity controls.

runTests.test_order_workflow_deducts_stock_and_cl: Workflow Stock Deduction and Cart Clear

descriptions.test_guest_order_place_redirects_to_logi: Verifies unauthenticated users posting to place-order are redirected to login.
descriptions.test_order_workflow_places_order_and_red: Verifies cart-to-order workflow redirects to /customer/orders and persists a Placed order.
descriptions.test_order_workflow_deducts_stock_and_cl: Verifies successful placement deducts inventory and clears cart rows.
descriptions.test_order_workflow_prevents_oversell_an: Verifies workflow blocks overselling and preserves cart when stock is insufficient.
descriptions.test_order_workflow_blocks_empty_cart: Verifies empty cart cannot be placed and user is redirected back to cart.
descriptions.test_customer_orders_list_shows_placed_o: Verifies orders list displays placed order status after successful workflow.

error_messages.test_order_workflow_places_order_and_red: Order workflow must create an order and redirect to orders list.
error_messages.test_order_workflow_deducts_stock_and_cl: Workflow must deduct stock and clear cart after placement.
error_messages.test_order_workflow_prevents_oversell_an: Workflow must prevent overselling and keep cart unchanged on failure.
error_messages.test_order_workflow_blocks_empty_cart: Workflow must reject empty-cart order placement.
error_messages.test_customer_orders_list_shows_placed_o: Placed order should appear on customer orders page.

tests.name: Customer cart shows place-order controls
tests.description: Login as seeded customer and verify cart page has total and place-order button structure.

tests.name: Customer completes cart to order workflow
tests.description: Add one product from catalog to cart, place order, and verify redirect to orders list.
